question: What is the difference between authentication and authorization?
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with early-career experience
description: Technical interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: Authentication verifies identity (who are you); authorization verifies permissions (what can you do). In my project, JWT tokens handle authentication (login), while role-based access control (RBAC) handles authorization (admin vs user). Both are essential: authentication without authorization is insecure, authorization without authentication is meaningless.
